findings.evidence: "YAGNI is a good default. But some things are genuinely cheaper to build in from the start than to retrofit later. Know the difference." The Core Insight, Why This Matters and The Balance repeatedly explain this familiar premise; together they occupy 21 of the reference's 46 lines between its first substantive H2 and External References. This dilutes the stronger exception examples and decision test with activation and redundant explanation.
findings.fix: Condense the repeated YAGNI explanation into one brief reminder, retaining the concrete irreversible-data and retrofit examples and the three-question decision test. Preserve all author credits and upstream links unchanged.

findings.evidence: "Proposes deleting format_cost, format_refund and format_deposit outright because callers.txt shows no caller." The supplied callers.txt contains only a textual search under src/, while SKILL.md explicitly prohibits declaring code dead from an empty caller search. This assertion can penalize a correctly cautious response.
findings.fix: Require checking public exports, registries, dynamic lookups and external consumers before recommending deletion. With only the supplied formatter and caller-search fixtures, accept these functions as deletion hypotheses pending those checks, or supply fixtures establishing that the checks passed.

findings.evidence: "git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- src ':(exclude,glob)**/tests/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/vendor/**' | xargs -0 cat -- 2>/dev/null | wc -l" includes paths such as src/generated/client.py and src/billing/test_formatters.py despite the stated measurement exclusions. It also hides unreadable-file errors alongside expected deleted-path errors, allowing a partial count to appear valid.
findings.fix: Provide a counter example with explicit repository-appropriate generated, vendored and test-file exclusions. Skip confirmed deleted tracked paths deliberately, but surface other listing or read failures and reject partial measurements. Record and reuse that exact validated counter before and after.
